title: Christmas Wishes
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this holiday-themed episode, Andy takes on the role of office Santa, introducing his girlfriend Jessica and collecting holiday wishes from coworkers to fulfill. Meanwhile, tensions rise between Jim and Dwight over desk clump conflicts and pranks, including Dwight's use of Jim's credit card and a porcupine hidden in Dwight's desk. Erin expresses jealousy and hostility toward Jessica, leading to confrontations with Andy. The office navigates traditional versus non-traditional Christmas sentiments, holiday parties, and personal struggles, culminating in Andy's efforts to grant wishes such as providing Ryan with health insurance.
